paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, chapter 11, halakhah 7, where he asks R' Yasa.[^1]

notes.text: Both personal titles are abbreviated and retained as R'. Ashyan asks Yasa, not the reverse. Jerusalem Talmud is the inherited format-based identification from chapter/halakhah notation, without an independently checked named passage.
